specs.title: invalid schedule cannot be saved and corrupted legacy browser storage recovers safely

a valid legacy plan migrates once into IndexedDB and survives reload without the old key
quota failure retains the last committed device plan and labels later edits as session-only
a failed hydration read cannot overwrite an existing device plan with an empty fallback
keyboard dialog focus is contained; Escape and Waiter close return focus without actions
mobile pages support keyboard switching, no horizontal overflow and motion fallbacks
